admin_sets_mark_price_occurred.meaning: admin has set the mark price, triggering _cacheImpactPrice

expired_orders_in_queue_occurred.meaning: expired orders remain present in the limit order queue

low_liquidity_condition_occurred.meaning: low-liquidity conditions exist in the market

funding_payments_false_occurred.meaning: funding payments and other markPrice-dependent safety checks relying on markPrice can become false
funding_payments_false_occurred.checkpoint: after impact price flows into markPrice

assumptions: The impact price snapshot including non-executable liquidity is the mechanism by which markPrice becomes distorted; this plan formalizes only the target impact that markPrice-dependent safety checks can become false.
The report does not claim an unauthorized caller; the admin setting the mark price is the stated trigger.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric bound or observed value for the impact price or mark price distortion, so the false-safety-check outcome is represented only as a grounded Boolean outcome.
Whether expired orders are present at the time of a specific _cacheImpactPrice call is not established by a prior transaction fragment.

limitations: The target impact is potential; the relation encodes only the report-supported conditional scenario, not an inevitable failure.
No concrete numeric values for impact price or mark price are supplied, so the safety-check failure is a qualitative Boolean observable.
